{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cradle Law''' was one of the base laws of Coynite society, and, under [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]] code of honor, was to be followed in the strictest sense. The law stated, in short, that no [[Gender/Legends|male]] Coynite could marry, own property, or otherwise disobey their father's wishes until he reached adulthood.
